statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes submitted were I34.0 and R42
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial was based on reason code CO-197 indicating required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
